title: Halted Configuration Is Fixed
statement: Let $m,d$ be natural numbers, let $[0m\Lambda$ be a type, let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program with states in $[0m\Lambda$, let $O$ assign a Boolean answer to each of the $d$ deciders on each bit string, and let $x$ be a bit string. For every choice bit $b$, register valuation $v : \\mathrm{Fin}(m) \\to \\mathbb{N}$, and optional Boolean result $r$, one step of the program on input $x$ with oracle $O$ leaves the halted configuration unchanged: $(\mathrm{none},v,r) \\mapsto (\mathrm{none},v,r)$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a nondeterministic register program with states in $[0m\Lambda$
